name: Separate an object from its neighbour
description: Push an object straight away from its closest neighbour until there is room for a finger (>= 3.5 cm gap) without leaving the support.

precheck.name: hand_empty
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: base_near
precheck.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: grasp_clearance
precheck.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: grasp_clearance
verifier.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
